provenance.method: Fresh-context read-only reviews mapped the fixed cohort to the original accepted intent; a separate targeted closure review checked the raw-evidence verifier repair.

original_request.summary: Reject genuine design and work leakage without rejecting concrete product scope, observable behavior, public contracts, finished-release properties, externally imposed mechanisms, or closed scope.

pairs.evidence: Product document scope remains acceptable; unsourced internal file placement remains implementation leakage.
Operator-visible outcomes remain acceptable; an author-selected state mechanism remains design leakage.
Externally consumed exit behavior remains acceptable; unconsumed exact log wording remains incidental implementation detail.

pairs.boundary: finished release property versus work instruction
pairs.evidence: Released behavior remains an outcome; repeated release-manager execution remains work content.

pairs.boundary: externally imposed mechanism versus unsourced preference
pairs.evidence: Identifiable regulatory mechanism remains admissible; author-selected simplicity preference remains inadmissible.
Contradiction-closed empty non-goals remain sufficient; open addable scope remains insufficiently fenced.
